evidence.title: AI social post design examples - posts.design

name: posts.design
summary: Hand-curated gallery of real social posts from 770+ brands, with OG images, profile headers and design trend write-ups.
description: A reference library of the social media posts brands and creators actually published: launches, updates, hiring posts, teasers, memes and more, each saved with images, account, date, category and post type, and a link to the original source. It also browses Open Graph link images and profile headers by brand, publishes editorial trend pages and teardowns, and serves a public search API.
contains: 866 Open Graph images and 575 profile headers
categories: launch, update, hiring, event, teaser, meme, partnership
each post links to its original source, with account, date and post type
public gallery search API (limit, offset, q, type, field, collection)
